generation_provenance_status: existing_provenance_not_replaced; full identity audit still pending

interpretation.actions: Ordered decomposition reviewed against available controller/event descriptions; not a newly executable planner.
interpretation.event_matching: Locates review candidates only; it does not prove the stated contact/guard nor exact micro-action interval.
interpretation.timing: Observed sample spans remain in their named clock. Point events are not expanded into invented intervals. No scoring milestone is used as an action boundary.
interpretation.loops: Hanoi repeats K01-K04 for each committed legal move; footfall and gait actions repeat. Numerical order is within a skill, not a universal serial schedule.
interpretation.branches: H3 heavy_prop only; asynchronous A/B operations may overlap.
interpretation.portable_evidence: Small excerpts below are portable; original absolute paths are provenance references, not deployment entrypoints. Raw full records still require the reference packages.
